publicationPolicy: Structural import, parsing, normalization, and search testing never confer publication approval. Promotion requires traceable source evidence plus named, dated human review with notes.

categoryNormalization.method: casefolded, collapsed-whitespace exact allow-list; no substring matching

selectionPolicy.ruleScope: Workbook admission only; explicit draft supplement is accounted separately

mediaPolicy: Workbook media remains reference_only_not_licensed_for_app and is never read or imported.
schemaResolution: Unknown abundance is encoded as regionalOccurrence=unknown. Printed scientific names remain source identity; taxonomy and measurements are null rather than asserting an accepted name or measurement type.
determinism: Workbook order is used only for row reporting; bundle, baseline, reasons, and batches use explicit stable ordering. Reports contain no run timestamp.

developmentSupplement.notice: Development-only, non-authoritative OCR-derived candidates. Text summaries are synthetically generated from controlled source terms, not independently reviewed biological prose. Source PDF not available to this run. Do not publish, promote, or claim 1000 verified creatures. Data supplements must be deterministically merged without lowering existing gates.
developmentSupplement.policy: Explicit development supplement; workbook gates and pending-review outcomes remain unchanged. Not source-verified or publication-approved.
